item.description:
VoiceClaw Realtime Companion 0.1.132

  • Allows multiple independent VoiceClaw sessions for the same OpenClaw agent with collision-free runtime identities.
  • Discovers sessions across both current and legacy OpenClaw gateway schemas without requiring OpenClaw changes.
  • Improves durable Work task retries, event delivery, multiline Hermes prompts, and returned-file instructions.
  • Preserves existing OpenClaw, Hermes, Codex, QR setup, and older-client compatibility.

VoiceClaw Realtime Companion 0.1.131

  • Uses the supported OpenClaw Gateway protocol tied to the selected OpenClaw installation, with an exact-binary CLI fallback.
  • Supports legacy agents.list, current agents.entries, and mixed OpenClaw agent/session response shapes.
  • Keeps the selected model route separate from the actual OpenClaw agent and reports structured, retryable runtime errors.
  • Adds runtime capability negotiation for current iPhone and Apple Watch builds while preserving compatibility with older clients.

VoiceClaw Realtime Companion 0.1.130

  • Adds durable concurrent route tasks with live status, steering, cancellation, and restart recovery.
  • Adds task-scoped input attachments and a bounded Companion-owned Artifact Inbox for returning files to iPhone.
  • Preserves QR/setup fields and explicitly selected credential families across schema v1, v2, and v3 regeneration.
  • Improves compatibility with current and legacy OpenClaw, Hermes, and Codex session response formats without modifying those installations.
